_meta.description: Curated, source-attributed facts that upstream datasets do not provide. Every entry must name a source and a confidence level. Never add a fact without a source. See docs/DATA_SOURCES.md for the review process.

sources.name: Community shiny-rate research (The Silph Road research archive; summarized on Bulbapedia 'Shiny Pokémon' in Pokémon GO)
sources.notes: Rates are community estimates, not official odds. Used only to choose a rate category (full-odds vs boosted), never shown as a probability.

tradableMythicals.note: Meltan and Melmetal are Mythical but can be traded (community-documented exception to the official 'Mythical Pokémon cannot be traded' rule).

releasedOverrides.note: Use to correct the released-species list between upstream updates. Each change must reference an official announcement in the commit message.

releasedForms.note: Hisuian/Paldean forms confirmed as released in Pokémon GO. Other Hisuian/Paldean forms in the game files stay 'unverified' until added here.

backgroundLinks.note: Map background id -> species ids on which that background was verifiably distributed. Empty until curated; unverified links never get a rarity score.
